function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock data or an API that gives me the current time.  
If you’re looking for the exact local time right now, the quickest way is to check your phone, computer, or a world‑clock website.  

Just remember that New York is in the Eastern Time Zone: it’s normally UTC−5 during standard time and UTC−4 when daylight‑saving time is in effect (which usually runs until the second Sunday in November). Once you know the current UTC time, subtract the appropriate offset to get the local time in New York.
